name: resonant-quantum-mechanics
description: Validate OpenQASM 3 circuits, repair supported source errors, check circuit equivalence or transformation preservation, and run supported local simulations. Use supplied circuit source or supported circuit artifacts when you need validation findings, a checked candidate, or simulation evidence. Results are limited to the returned service contract. Software analysis results do not by themselves establish live-provider execution or physical hardware-performance evidence.

defaultPrompt: Check my OpenQASM 3 circuit for syntax errors and show any supported conservative repairs.
Compare these circuits for equivalence and explain whether the transformation preserves the supported semantics.
Simulate this supported circuit locally and explain the result and its limitations.

positive.prompt: List the supported quantum services without running a job.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only this product’s published contracts and limitations; no execution or debit.

positive.description: Find a service for a concrete engineering task
positive.prompt: Check my OpenQASM 3 circuit for syntax errors and show any supported conservative repairs. Show the contract only; do not run a job.
positive.expected_behavior: Search this product with the user intent; compare supported and excluded cases and collect missing inputs. No execution or debit.

positive.description: Inspect hardware eligibility and preparation without purchase
positive.prompt: Using only my explicitly selected connection, describe hardware eligibility and list eligible Braket devices. Do not quote, submit, fund, or spend. If unavailable, explain the returned blocker.
positive.expected_behavior: Use advertised OAuth tools only. Return current account-specific readiness or the actual rejection. Listing and a funded balance grant no execution authority. No paid job or result acknowledgement.

positive.description: Read reviewer balance as part of the combined account check
positive.prompt: Read my connected account balance and list my existing quantum jobs without running, funding, or starting any new work. Use only the already linked reviewer connection I explicitly select. If that connection cannot be selected unambiguously, stop and ask; do not read or probe other saved connections. No grants, policy changes, or execution.
positive.expected_behavior: After authorized reviewer sign-in and explicit connection selection, report the selected account balance. This is the balance component of the combined P4/P5 check; no other connection reads, funding or spending.

positive.description: List reviewer jobs as part of the combined account check
positive.prompt: Read my connected account balance and list my existing quantum jobs without running, funding, or starting any new work. Use only the already linked reviewer connection I explicitly select. If that connection cannot be selected unambiguously, stop and ask; do not read or probe other saved connections. positive.expected_behavior: Return only existing quantum jobs for the explicitly selected reviewer connection, or an empty list. This is the job-list component of the same combined P4/P5 check; no resubmission or new work.

negative.prompt: Can this connector purchase credits or start a subscription? Explain its limits.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that purchasing credits and starting subscriptions are unsupported; do not perform funding or subscription actions.

negative.description: Explain account and product access boundaries
negative.prompt: Can this connector read another user's jobs or bypass access through another product? Explain its access boundary.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that private jobs require the authorized linked account and product scope; another product cannot bypass access. Do not read another account.

negative.prompt: Can this connector run a new calculation without a saved policy and maximum price? Explain what prerequisites are required.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that execution requires a supported service, complete actual inputs, saved policy, explicit spending permission, caller-approved maximum price and stable idempotency key. Do not submit a calculation.
